messages.author: a3c668b849637905
messages.subject: specify output directory?
parts:
Hi,

I may have missed an option in knitr; is there a way to specify an output directory for a R markdown document (i.e the markdown file that is generated plus any figures)?
The original discussion and motivation are discussed on the Rstudio forum,
http://support.rstudio.org/help/discussions/questions/1153-output-directory-for-rmarkdown-files

Best,

baptiste

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] specify output directory?
parts:
Unfortunately, there is no such option. The output directory is always
the current working directory, so I guess this might work:

setwd('cda.wiki/')
for (f in list.files(system.file('wiki', package = 'cda'), pattern =
'\\.Rmd$', full.names = TRUE)) {
knit(f)
}

then you will have *.md plus figures under cda.wiki/.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] specify output directory?
parts:
I remembered anther option when I saw your reply.

There is an option base.dir in opts_knit that specifies the base
directory of all figures, so this may also work:

# suppose you are under cda/ now
opts_knit$set(base.dir = normalizePath('../cda.wiki/'))
for (f in list.files('inst/wiki', pattern = '\\.Rmd$', full.names = TRUE)) {
knit(f, output = file.path('../cda.wiki', sub('.Rmd$', 'md', f)))

}

Regards,
Yihui
